passages.text: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As surely as the LORD lives—the God of Israel before whom I stand—there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet.
Elijah came from the people who lived in Gilead.
Elijah spoke to Ahab, the king of Israel.
Elijah said, “The LORD is alive.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
I stand before the LORD.
There will not be dew in these years.
There will not be rain in these years.
This will happen only when I say so.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֜י מִתֹּשָׁבֵ֣י גִלְעָד֮ אֶל־ אַחְאָב֒ חַי־ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְפָנָ֔יו אִם־ יִהְיֶ֛ה הַשָּׁנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה טַ֣ל וּמָטָ֑ר כִּ֖י אִם־ לְפִ֥י דְבָרִֽי׃ס

passages.text: Then a revelation from the LORD came to Elijah: “Leave here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Elijah.
The LORD gave Elijah a message.
The LORD told Elijah to leave this place.
The LORD told Elijah to go east.
The LORD told Elijah to hide.
The LORD told Elijah to hide by the Brook of Cherith.
The Brook of Cherith is east of the Jordan River.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃ לֵ֣ךְ מִזֶּ֔ה וּפָנִ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ קֵ֑דְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: And you are to drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Elijah.
God told Elijah to drink water from the brook.
God said, “I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֖ה מֵהַנַּ֣חַל תִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְאֶת־ הָעֹרְבִ֣ים צִוִּ֔יתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ֖ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: So Elijah did what the LORD had told him, and he went and lived by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Elijah.
The LORD gave Elijah a command.
Elijah obeyed the LORD.
Elijah left his place.
Elijah went to the Brook of Cherith.
The Brook of Cherith is east of the Jordan River.
Elijah lived by the Brook of Cherith.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening, and he would drink from the brook.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah lived by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
God commanded the ravens to help Elijah.
The ravens brought Elijah bread and meat in the morning.
The ravens brought Elijah bread and meat in the evening.
Elijah drank water from the brook.
passages.original: וְהָעֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּבָשָׂר֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְלֶ֥חֶם וּבָשָׂ֖ר בָּעָ֑רֶב וּמִן־ הַנַּ֖חַל יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Some time later, however, the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He lived by the Brook of Cherith.
After some days, the brook dried up.
No rain had fallen in the land.
The lack of rain caused the brook to dry.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִקֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים וַיִּיבַ֣שׁ הַנָּ֑חַל כִּ֛י לֹֽא־ הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Get up and go to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Elijah.
The LORD gave Elijah a command.
The LORD said, “Get up.
Go to Zarephath.
Zarephath is in Sidon.
Stay there.
I have commanded a widow in Zarephath to provide for you.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃ ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֙תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְצִיד֔וֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: So Elijah got up and went to Zarephath. When he arrived at the city gate, there was a widow gathering sticks. Elijah called to her and said, “Please bring me a little water in a cup, so that I may drink.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah got up.
He went to Zarephath.
He arrived at the city gate.
A widow was there.
She was gathering sticks.
Elijah called to the widow.
He said, “Please bring me a little water in a cup.”
He said, “I want to drink.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָה וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּֽה־ שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר קְחִי־ נָ֨א לִ֧י מְעַט־ מַ֛יִם בַּכְּלִ֖י וְאֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃

passages.text: And as she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a piece of bread.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
A widow was gathering sticks at the city gate of Zarephath.
Elijah asked the widow for water.
The widow started to go get water for Elijah.
Elijah called to the widow again.
Elijah said, “Please bring me a piece of bread in your hand.”
passages.original: וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לָקַ֑חַת וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר לִֽקְחִי־ נָ֥א לִ֛י פַּת־ לֶ֖חֶם בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: But she replied, “As surely as the LORD your God lives, I have no bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. Look, I am gathering a couple of sticks to take home and prepare a meal for myself and my son, so that we may eat it and die.”
passages.sermon:
A widow stood at the city gate in Zarephath.
She gathered sticks.
Elijah asked her for water and bread.
She answered Elijah.
She said, “As surely as the LORD your God lives, I have no bread.”
She had only a handful of flour in a jar.
She had only a little oil in a jug.
She was gathering two sticks.
She planned to go home.
She would make a meal for herself and her son.
They would eat it.
Then they would die.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אִם־ יֶשׁ־ לִ֣י מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם־ מְלֹ֤א כַף־ קֶ֙מַח֙ בַּכַּ֔ד וּמְעַט־ שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּצַּפָּ֑חַת וְהִנְנִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּבָ֙אתִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֙יהוּ֙ לִ֣י וְלִבְנִ֔י וַאֲכַלְנֻ֖הוּ וָמָֽתְנוּ׃

passages.text: “Do not be afraid,” Elijah said to her. “Go and do as you have said. But first make me a small cake of bread from what you have, and bring it out to me. Afterward, make some for yourself and your son, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD, the God of Israel.
Elijah spoke to the woman.
He said, “Do not be afraid.
Go and do as you have said.
But first, make me a small cake of bread from what you have.
Bring it out to me.
After that, make some for yourself and your son.
The LORD, the God of Israel, says this.
The jar of flour will not be used up.
The jug of oil will not run dry.
This will last until the day the LORD sends rain on the land.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י בֹּ֖אִי עֲשִׂ֣י כִדְבָרֵ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ עֲשִׂי־ לִ֣י מִ֠שָּׁם עֻגָ֨ה קְטַנָּ֤ה בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ וְהוֹצֵ֣אתְ לִ֔י וְלָ֣ךְ וְלִבְנֵ֔ךְ תַּעֲשִׂ֖י בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃ס כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם תִּתֶּן יְהוָ֛ה גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: So she went and did according to the word of Elijah, and there was food every day for Elijah and the woman and her household.
passages.sermon:
The woman listened to Elijah.
She did what Elijah told her.
Elijah ate food.
The woman ate food.
Her household ate food.
They had food for many days.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתֹּ֧אכַל הוּא־ וָהִיא וּבֵיתָ֖הּ יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not run dry, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Elijah.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through Elijah.
God promised that the flour would not run out.
God promised that the oil would not become empty.
The jar of flour did not run out.
The jug of oil did not become empty.
This happened just as God said through Elijah.
passages.original: כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּיַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

passages.text: Later, the son of the woman who owned the house became ill, and his sickness grew worse and worse, until no breath remained in him.
passages.sermon:
The woman owned the house.
She had a son.
Some time passed after these events.
Her son became ill.
His sickness became very severe.
He grew worse and worse.
At last, he stopped breathing.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה חָלָ֕ה בֶּן־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת וַיְהִ֤י חָלְיוֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ נֽוֹתְרָה־ בּ֖וֹ נְשָׁמָֽה׃

passages.text: “O man of God,” said the woman to Elijah, “what have you done to me? Have you come to remind me of my iniquity and cause the death of my son?”
passages.sermon:
A woman spoke to Elijah.
Elijah was a prophet of God.
The woman owned the house where Elijah was staying.
Her son had become very sick and died.
She said to Elijah, “Man of God, what have you done to me?”
She asked, “Did you come here to remind me of my sin?”
She also asked, “Did you come to cause my son to die?”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה־ לִּ֥י וָלָ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛י לְהַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת־ עֲוֺנִ֖י וּלְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנִֽי׃

passages.text: But Elijah said to her, “Give me your son.” So he took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
Elijah spoke to the woman.
He said, “Give me your son.”
The woman gave her son to Elijah.
Elijah took the boy from her arms.
Elijah carried the boy to the upper room.
Elijah was staying in that upper room.
Elijah laid the boy on his own bed.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖יהָ תְּנִֽי־ לִ֣י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֑ךְ וַיִּקָּחֵ֣הוּ מֵחֵיקָ֗הּ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖הוּ עַל־ מִטָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he cried out to the LORD, “O LORD my God, have You also brought tragedy on this widow who has opened her home to me, by causing her son to die?”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
A widow had opened her home to Elijah.
The widow’s son had died.
Elijah cried out to the LORD.
He said, “O LORD my God, have You also brought tragedy on this widow?”
He said, “She has let me stay with her.”
He said, “Have You caused her son to die?”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י הֲ֠גַם עַל־ הָאַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛הּ הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ לְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the LORD, “O LORD my God, please let this boy’s life return to him!”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
Elijah stretched himself out over the child.
He did this three times.
Elijah cried out to the LORD.
He said, “O LORD my God, please let this boy’s life return to him.”
passages.original: וַיִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל־ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י תָּ֥שָׁב נָ֛א נֶֽפֶשׁ־ הַיֶּ֥לֶד הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־ קִרְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah, and the child’s life returned to him, and he lived.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Elijah is a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah prayed to the LORD.
The LORD listened to Elijah’s voice.
The child had died.
The LORD returned the child’s life to him.
The child became alive again.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בְּק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתָּ֧שָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ־ הַיֶּ֛לֶד עַל־ קִרְבּ֖וֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃

passages.text: Then Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. “Look, your son is alive,” Elijah declared.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah took the child.
He brought the child down from the upper room.
He brought the child into the house.
He gave the child to his mother.
Elijah said, “Look, your son is alive.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיֹּרִדֵ֤הוּ מִן־ הָעֲלִיָּה֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רְאִ֖י חַ֥י בְּנֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is truth.”
passages.sermon:
The woman spoke to Elijah.
She said, “Now I know this.”
She said, “You are a man of God.”
She said, “The word of the LORD from your mouth is true.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֑תָּה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה בְּפִ֖יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃פ
